flow           process left to right: inputs -> processing -> results
lanes          swimlane — who does what, in which order (client / assistant / human)
sequence       who sends what to whom, message by message (lanes + columns)
mindmap        one topic branching into ideas (radial, a colour per branch)
matrix         2×2 — what first: effect × effort, quick wins tinted
compare        options × criteria as a table card, the decision as a note
schema         data schema / ERD — tables with fields, FK rows linked
before-after   now vs with the assistant, revealed as two presentation steps
